title.narrative: Improvement of the solid waste management system in the City of Samarkand

description.narrative: The main objective of the Project is to fully modernize the municipal waste collection and disposal process, and to enhance the waste recycling with the financing by both AFD loan and IFCA grants of : - the acquisition of 70 waste collection vehicles and building of a maintenance workshop - the building of a landfill compliant to modern standards, in the form of a bioreactor landfill (with leachate recirculation in order to maximize landfill gas valorisation), including gas treatment units)

comment.narrative: tonsyear. The following elements have been assumed to estimate total municipal waste produced and collected during the next 20 years Population annual growth of 1.5 starting at 500000 people in 2014 Specific household waste production annual growth of 0.5 Collection rate annual growth of 2 starting at 30 in 2014 Using these assumptions and taking into consideration the latest background and population growth in Samarkand the population reaches almost 815000 people in 2035 and the annual waste production increases to 360000 tons of which 72 or 260000 tons are being collected and disposed of at the landfill source preliminary feasibility study by AFD.
